protocol: EIP-4895 beacon-chain withdrawals as execution-payload operations

source.availability: completed source hour plus fixed 180-second confirmation delay

economic_screen.source_event: completed hourly withdrawal amount at or above the prior-only rolling 720-hour 90th percentile
economic_screen.long_geometry: event-hour low structural invalidation and prior-only 24-hour high objective
economic_screen.short_geometry: event-hour high structural invalidation and prior-only 24-hour low objective
economic_screen.entry: first observable ETHUSDT one-minute open after source availability plus fixed 500ms order latency
economic_screen.gap_stop: observed one-minute open when beyond the structural stop
economic_screen.model: eight fixed-seed event-bootstrap HGBT regressors of direct 24bp account action value; score is mean minus 0.5 standard deviation

decision_rule: A negative, sign-unstable, sparse or winner-dependent forward confirmation retires the exact information unit without threshold, delay, geometry, cost, risk or leverage rescue.
